findings.message: 2 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 2 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "TONIGHT · SUNDAY 19 OCTOBER · 18:42" above "“The sky wasn't dark yet, but it wasn't "; "Sunday, October 19th, 2026 · 6:42 pm" above "The lamps came on before I got home"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 2 tiny uppercase letter-spaced label(s): "TONIGHT · SUNDAY 19 OCTOBER · 18:42", "ON REPEAT"
findings.fix: Prefer sentence case at body size.

findings.message: 1 gradient fill(s): div.a-glow → radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(255, 196, 120, 0.42), rgba(255, 196, 120, 0))
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 3 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.pol.pol1 → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55) 0px 18px 40px 0px | div.pol.pol2 → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55) 0px 18px 40px 0px | div.ticket → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5) 0px 12px 30px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).
One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: 5 typefaces in use (Hanken Grotesk, Newsreader, Verdana, Cormorant, Reenie Beanie).
findings.fix: Two at most: one display, one text. Often one is enough.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 13px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: The sheet dealt Schibsted Grotesk and Schibsted Grotesk, but the page renders Hanken Grotesk, Newsreader.
findings.fix: Load the dealt face (the link on the sheet) and put it first in font-family. A build that falls back to a default face lands on the default look.
One h1 per page; section titles are h2.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "after, writing it down" (screen 3, 100% hidden); "the shore, last week" (screen 3, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "The lamps came on before I got home" → 3 lines (8 words, 44px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.
